methods.B: Hypothesis ranking within fixed C3 pool; preserves B Top-10
methods.B_top1_then_RRF60: Pin hypothesis Top-1, followed by current RRF excluding that file

pool: Same hypothesis Top-40 plus original unique padding to 50; never change candidate pool
success_screen: MAP at least 0.005 higher than both B and current RRF; MRR no lower than current RRF; Top10 hit count no lower than B; positive MAP difference against current RRF in both preassigned halves
failure_policy: Keep failures as zero, no replacement or fallback
evaluation: One fixed run, no subsequent parameter tuning; report all candidates and win/tie/loss, repair of current losses and harm to current wins
scope: Exploratory development-data diagnosis, not independent validation: all 500 were already observed. Exclude old pilot45; per-project sample without labels/outcomes, ten per project, fixed halves of five each. Do not evaluate new rules on all500 or call any GPU model.
